src/validate.py:
def validate(rows):
    return [r for r in rows if isinstance(r.get("kind"), str) and isinstance(r.get("title"), str) and r["title"].strip()]
src/normalize.py:
def normalize(rows):
    return [(r["kind"].strip().lower(), r["title"].strip()) for r in rows]
src/render.py:
def render(rows):
    return "\n".join(f"{kind}: {title}" for kind, title in sorted(rows, key=lambda r: r[0]))
src/selection.py:
def select(rows):
    return [r for r in rows if r[0] in {"fix", "feat"}]
